rotation_rules.Definition: A new painting from the pool each time the screen opens; no repeat until the pool cycles (shuffle bag).
rotation_rules.Key / seed: Pool order shuffled per user; remember last N shown

rotation_rules.Definition: One painting per calendar day (date-seeded), the same all day on every screen that uses the slot.
rotation_rules.Typical slots: Door covers in Ordinary time, novena covers

rotation_rules.Definition: Changes every Sunday (first Vespers rule optional).

Pool subsets bound to weekdays: Sunday Resurrection/Trinity · Monday Holy Souls/Holy Ghost · Tuesday angels/St Anthony · Wednesday St Joseph · Thursday Eucharist · Friday Passion/Sacred Heart · Saturday Our Lady.
rotation_rules.Typical slots: Pray home, door covers, Morning prayer

rotation_rules.Definition: Subsets for morning (before 11:00), midday (11:00–15:00), afternoon/evening (15:00–20:00), night (after 20:00).
rotation_rules.Key / seed: local time → NAT-DAWN / NAT-MIDDAY / NAT-DUSK / NAT-NIGHT

rotation_rules.Definition: Pool filtered to the current season; falls back to the 'all seasons' subset when the season subset is empty.
rotation_rules.Typical slots: Pray home hero, door covers, Rosary cover

rotation_rules.Definition: Pool boosted by the traditional month devotion (e.g. March St Joseph, May Our Lady, June Sacred Heart, July Precious Blood, Oct Rosary, Nov Holy Souls).
A specific feast or date replaces any other rule for that day (e.g. 25 Mar Annunciation on the Angelus cover).
rotation_rules.Typical slots: Pray home hero, Angelus, Marian covers

rotation_rules.Definition: Each card/stage/day of a sequence has its own pool; rotation inside that pool uses the stage's secondary rule (default R-SESSION).

rotation_rules.Definition: One canonical image (pool of 1). Use sparingly; for iconic devotional images where variation would confuse.
